pontos: Establishes a transition regime for the substitute contribution of Law 12.546/2011 (arts. 7 and 8)
Includes a transition for the surcharge on the Cofins-Importação (Law 10.865/2004)
Amends seven laws, among them Laws 8.212/1991, 8.742/1993 and 13.988/2020
Repeals provisions of two decree-laws and of three laws
